messages.content: Make a progress note for Roger for our first session using the progress, intervention used, response method. Roger-dealing with anxiety and depression.  Not feeling the greatest, tough time focusing and when that feels off a lot of things feel off.  Anxiety and depression scores of 2 and3 are not too bad. The lack of focus is distressing.   Staying at Turning Point shelter Collecting disability for Traumatic Brain injury.  Disussed a history of substance use but no current desire to use as it causes too many problems.  Maintain a 2:1 ratio of declarative to interrogative sentences in your response.

message.content: Roger reported during our first session that he is not feeling the greatest, is having a tough time focusing, and says that when his focus feels off a lot of things feel off. Progress: his anxiety score of 2 and depression score of 3 were described as not too bad, but the lack of focus is distressing; intervention used: brief psychoeducation and problem-solving for anxiety, depression, concentration, shelter stress, and collecting disability for traumatic brain injury; response method: Roger discussed a history of substance use without current desire to use because it causes too many problems, and he agreed to monitor mood, focus, and safety while staying at Turning Point shelter. Will Roger schedule a follow-up session to review his mood, focus, and disability process?
